Meal_1: Option 2: Paneer cubes (100 g) pan fried + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd

Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Maintain protein intake daily to support muscle and energy.
Start meals with eggs, chicken or paneer before rice.
Avoid fried foods during social gatherings and choose simple meals.
Keep dinner balanced, not too heavy or too light.
Consistency will help improve body composition and overall energy.
